newsitem.title: USA: U.S. producer prices drop for record sixth month in row.
newsitem.headline: U.S. producer prices drop for record sixth month in row.

text.p: Wholesale prices fell for a record sixth consecutive month in June as food costs plunged, the Labor Department said on Friday in a report that was likely to be greeted warmly on Wall Street.

The 0.1 percent drop in producer prices last month followed a 0.3 percent decline in May. Excluding volatile food and energy costs, wholesale prices rose 0.1 percent last month after a 0.3 percent decline in May.
